requirements.rule: ANNUAL MINIMI: the minimi of the CCNL are updated every year from 1 January by the Commissione nazionale (Art. 38, ISTAT variation of the consumer prices); the bundle holds the table of 2026. From 1 January 2027 the amounts are those of 2026 until the 2027 table is published and added, so a 2027 run is not payable.
requirements.remediation: Add the minimi of 2027 set by the Commissione nazionale with their source, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: Art. 34 cc. 3, 4, 7: the engine pays the level-specific allowances only while the caller states the qualifying roles. It cannot independently verify a child's age, the number of persons assisted, or certification validity, written notice and delivery of its copy. Nor does it automatically offset the allowances of cc. 3 and 4 against an individual superminimo or that of c. 7 against better treatment received overall; the caller must state individual pay net of any offset.
requirements.remediation: Verify role eligibility externally and state individual pay net of any offset; to automate this, model child age, assisted persons, certification validity and notice, and the applicable offsets.

requirements.rule: The INPS contributions of the tredicesima are paid on the hours of the year: INPS bands them on the paga oraria effettiva, which spreads the tredicesima over the hours, so the tredicesima run charges no INPS hours. The Cas.Sa.Colf contribution of Art. 54 c. 2 is charged on the contributable hours the run states, a tredicesima run too: no bundled source says whether the tredicesima carries hours of its own for it.
requirements.remediation: Source from the Cas.Sa.Colf rules whether the tredicesima carries contributable hours and set them for extra-month runs.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: SINGLE PERIOD 2026-01-01. Pre-2026 tranches out of scope. Post-2026 CCNL 2025-2028 tranches not yet modelled: +30 on BS convivente from Jan 2027, +15 from Jan 2028, +15 from Sep 2028 (other levels proportional — exact amounts require official ASSINDATCOLF/DOMINA table for those periods).
requirements.remediation: Add the 2027 and 2028 tranches from the official ASSINDATCOLF/DOMINA tables.
